content.text: {"name":"Separation-rate change interaction with hours, 36m tsz","hypothesis":"Groups with rising V02 over 3 months while hours (V01) are weak versus a 36-month history face labor stress and have lower next-month returns; a shorter window should keep the negative sign, with stable low and high T ICs.","falsified_if":"Mean IC is positive or |HAC t| is below 2 in development statistics, or low_T and high_T ICs have opposite signs.","expression":"mult(chg(V02,3),tsz(V01,36))"}
